title: Obs and Gynae: reflection and OSCE prompts
description: Obstetric history, examination and consent practice.

questions.q: OSCE: Take an obstetric history from a woman at 28 weeks.
questions.answer: Model: presenting issue, GTPAL, previous pregnancies and deliveries, current pregnancy (movements, bleeding, headaches), medical, drug and social history.

questions.q: How did I ensure consent and dignity when observing an intimate encounter?
questions.answer: Model: ask permission, offer chaperone, respect refusal, thank the patient.

questions.q: OSCE: Explain how to measure fundal height.
questions.answer: Model: consent, position, measure from fundus to symphysis pubis, compare with gestation in weeks, escalate if discrepant.
